title: Fourier Coefficient Decay under Hölder Continuity

problemStatement.plain: Alpha-Hölder continuous functions on the circle have Fourier coefficients decaying as O(|n|^{-alpha}). This quantifies how regularity controls spectral decay.
whyMatters: Foundational result in harmonic analysis connecting regularity to spectral decay
Corollaries include Riemann-Lebesgue lemma and uniform convergence criteria

proven: Quotient metric bound dist_translate_le via QuotientAddGroup.norm_mk_le_norm
Haar translation invariance integral_translate_eq via integral_add_right_eq_self
open: Riemann-Lebesgue corollary (quantitative rate, needs finiteness argument)
knownResults.goal: Complete all sorries to get a fully verified formalization
